description: List the discussion comments on a work item. This is separate from the transcript of any linked crew. Every comment carries a boolean `clientVisible`: true when it is shared with the client on shared reports, false when it is internal. ONE PAGE per call (50 by default, 100 max): the result carries `meta` with `hasMore`, `nextCursor` and `appliedFilters`. When `meta.hasMore` is true, pass `meta.nextCursor` back as `cursor` to get the next page. Pass `since` to read only comments created after a moment (for example the time you last read the thread); keep the same `since` while paging.

since.description: Only comments created after this moment: an ISO 8601 timestamp with a time zone (2026-10-27T09:00:00Z), a date read as UTC midnight, or epoch milliseconds. Anything else is refused with 400 invalid_since.

name: anyforge_list_work_item_comments
title: List work item comments
